final: WITH f AS (SELECT category, remaining, amount - spent AS diff FROM budget WHERE amount > 75), g AS (SELECT category, AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining, SUM(diff) AS total FROM f GROUP BY category), o AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS overall FROM g) SELECT g.category, g.avg_remaining, g.total, g.total - o.overall AS above_avg FROM g, o WHERE o.overall IS NOT NULL AND g.total > o.overall
